_note: Reference deal for the KasVault OTC swap slot v3. Every value below was read back from chain on 2026-11-08; the four transaction hops are the complete life of one deal (kvault sold for QTC).

qtc_lock.check: buyer locks 40026 sat in a P2WSH hash lock

qtc_claim.check: the desk spends the hash lock, so the witness now carries the 32-byte preimage S; blake2b(S) equals the slot's hash

kvault_relay.check: IN0 is the slot covenant, OUT0 is the 0.5 KAS KCC20 carrier holding the 10000 kvault; consensus accepted the tx, which proves blake2b(OUT0 scriptPubKey) == presenceHash

reproduce.source_to_abi: silverc tok_slot_v3.sil --constructor-args tok_slot_v3_compile_args.json -o abi.json && diff <(jq -S . abi.json) <(jq -S . tok_slot_v3_artifact.json)
reproduce.note: The compile args are placeholders, exactly as for the stake pool: the real values are the state fields above and end up in the compiled script, not in the shipped ABI.
